## 最近更新

每天围绕一个问题，读三篇经颅光刺激论文和一篇相关的 fMRI 脑网络论文。[按问题读 →](questions.qmd) 也可在下方筛选单篇笔记。

```{=html}
<div id="notes-topics" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3" role="group" aria-label="按主题筛选笔记">
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-topic="" aria-pressed="true">全部</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-topic="经颅光刺激" aria-pressed="false">经颅光刺激</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary" data-topic="fMRI 脑网络" aria-pressed="false">fMRI 脑网络</button>
</div>
<script>
  const noteTopics = document.querySelectorAll("#notes-topics button");
  const requestedTopic = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1)).get("category") || "";
  for (const button of noteTopics) {
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(button.dataset.topic === requestedTopic));
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      window.quartoListingCategory(btoa(encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.topic)));
      for (const option of noteTopics) {
        option.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(option === button));
      }
    });
  }
</script>
```

:::{#notes}
:::

想分享阅读笔记？写清论文问了什么、怎么做、得到了什么结果。关键结果可标注原文页码或图表。[查看提交方式](../join/index.qmd)。
